target_subsystem: ezEngine ColonyPlugin - Module 113 (Deep Crust Geothermal Fracturing & Superheated Brine Desalination)
failure_signature: Overpressure fracture injection failed to trigger catastrophic casing collapse
root_cause_analysis: In ezColonyGeothermalDesalinationSystem::Update, when induced seismic stress rapidly climbed from 40% to 100% in a single timestep, the code evaluated 'if (stress >= MAX_SAFE_SEISMIC_STRESS_PERCENT)' (80%) first and transitioned the state to InducedSeismicTremorWarning. The 100% threshold check for CatastrophicCasingCollapse was sequestered in an 'else if' block for the warning state, preventing immediate transition upon sudden extreme overpressure.
